name: search_documents
description: Search corporate knowledge base and document repository using a general full-text search query string.

query.description: The general search query string to look for in document body content.

name: search_document_by_title
description: Find and locate documents matching an exact or partial document headline or file title.

title.description: The specific title or headline of the document to search for.

name: search_document_by_keyword
description: Filter and retrieve documents tagged with a specific standardized taxonomy metadata keyword or tag.

keyword.description: The exact metadata tag or category keyword attached to documents.

name: search_products
description: Search e-commerce product catalog for items matching a general text description or search query.

query.description: Keywords or search term describing the products.

name: search_products_by_category
description: Browse and list all retail products belonging to a specific department or store category.

category.description: Department or category name, e.g. electronics, footwear, books.

name: find_product_by_name
description: Look up an exact retail item or merchandise by its specific commercial brand name or model label.

product_name.description: The specific commercial product name or exact brand model name.

name: search_customers
description: Search customer directory database by general customer query string, matching name, email, or company.

query.description: Search phrase to look up in customer records.

name: get_customer_profile
description: Retrieve comprehensive contact profile, registration information, and account status for a specific customer ID.

customer_id.description: The unique customer account identifier, e.g. CUST-10492.

name: search_orders
description: Search order database records across multiple orders matching a general keyword or search term.

query.description: Search keywords matching order items, notes, or customer descriptions.

name: get_order_status
description: Retrieve the current delivery, fulfillment, or shipping progress status for a specific order ID.

order_id.description: The unique order identifier code, e.g. ORD-98124.

name: get_order_details
description: Retrieve the complete itemized billing invoice, purchased item list, pricing breakdown, and payment details for a specific order ID.

order_id.description: The unique purchase order code, e.g. ORD-98124.

name: get_weather
description: Retrieve current real-time atmospheric weather conditions, temperature, and humidity for a specified city.

city.description: The city or municipality name, e.g. London or Chicago.

units.description: Measurement units for temperature: celsius or fahrenheit.

name: get_forecast
description: Retrieve multi-day future weather projections, meteorological forecasts, and rain probabilities for upcoming days.

days.description: Number of future days to forecast (1 to 14).

name: search_restaurants
description: Discover and find dining restaurants matching a preferred culinary cuisine type and city/location.

cuisine.description: Type of culinary food, e.g. Italian, Thai, Mexican, Japanese.

location.description: City or neighborhood location to search.

name: find_restaurants_nearby
description: Search for eating places and restaurants located in close physical proximity to a specific landmark or address.

location.description: Reference street address or geographic landmark.

name: calculate
description: Safely evaluate mathematical expressions and compute numerical arithmetic calculations.

name: convert_currency
description: Convert a specific monetary amount from a source currency into a target foreign currency using current exchange rates.

amount.description: The numerical amount of money to convert.

from_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code to convert from, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

to_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code to convert into, e.g. JPY, EUR, INR.

name: search_web
description: Perform an open web search across internet websites and public online resources for a general query.

query.description: General search query for web search.

name: search_news
description: Search recent journalistic articles, published headlines, and current news coverage by topic.

query.description: The news topic or headline subject to search.

name: get_calendar_events
description: Retrieve user calendar schedule, meetings, and calendar events planned for a specific date.

date.description: The calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-11-15.

name: schedule_meeting
description: Schedule and create a new event or appointment on the user calendar with a title, time, and attendees.

title.description: Title or subject of the meeting.

start_time.description: Start timestamp in ISO or descriptive format, e.g. 2026-11-15 14:00.

name: calculate_shipping
description: Calculate estimated parcel shipping fee and freight costs based on package weight and transit distance.

weight.description: Package weight in kilograms or pounds.

distance.description: Shipping distance in miles or kilometers.

name: track_shipment
description: Track real-time carrier delivery progress, transit scans, and delivery ETA for a package using its tracking number.

tracking_number.description: The courier carrier tracking identifier code, e.g. TRK-482910.

name: check_inventory
description: Check real-time warehouse inventory stock levels and unit availability count for a specific item SKU or product ID.

product_id.description: The unique product SKU or catalog ID, e.g. SKU-8842.
